    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Project Overview\n",
        "---\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Data was loaded from:\n",
        "(https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/uciml/iris)\n",
        "\n",
        "This project completes a complete and Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) on the Iris dataset. This dataset is one of the most used datasets in Data Science.\n",
        "The goal of this analysis is to understand how the three flower species, namely Iris-setosa, Iris-versicolor and Iris-virginica, differ from each other using statistics and charts.\n",
        "\n",
        "**The project uses the following technologies:**\n",
        "\n",
        "*   Python\n",
        "*   Pandas\n",
        "*   Seaborn\n",
        "*   Matplotlib\n",
        "\n",
        "# The Analysis and Visualisation\n",
        "---\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "The first task was to tally the number of times each species was sampled in the dataset. The was a perfect balance between all the species at 50 samples each.\n",
        "\n",
        "The second task was to create histograms of the data for each column establish how each flower's properties differ from the other.\n",
        "\n",
        "The properties analysed were SepalLength, SepalWidth, PetalLengthCm, PetalWidth in centimeters per species.\n",
        "\n",
        "**The results were as follows:**\n",
        "![histogram.png](data:image/png;base64,)\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "I6MA6KmOzZuv"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "*   The Iris-setosa appears to have a great numer of plants that have smaller petal and sepal lengths, and also petal width. However, its sepal width is on average larger than that of the other two species(in cm).\n",
        "*   The Iris-vercosa shows an average size for all properties.\n",
        "\n",
        "* Petals showed more extreme differences per species.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Box-plots were then used to further distinguish the species in terms of their propeties.\n",
        "\n",
        "**The results were as follows:**\n",
        "![boxplot.png](data:image/png;base64,)\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "40ge3hCw4nU0"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "*  Petals size differences in width and length per species are larger than the differences in sepal sizes.\n",
        "*   The box-plot clearly displays the largest property in the species being the sepal length with the highest recorded length with the Iris-virginica holding that record.\n",
        "*   The sepals also show the highest recorded width with the Iris-sertosa holding that record.\n",
        "\n",
        "A bivariate and multivariate analysis was conducted through a Pairplot.\n",
        "\n",
        "**The results were as follows:**\n",
        "![pairplot.png](data:image/png;base64,)\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "YAdGcRO17Mmi"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "*   The Iris-setosa continues to form distinct clusters. The Iris-versicolor and Iris-virginica often overlap making them harder to distinguish from one another.\n",
        "*   Iris-virginica generally has larger petals and sepals.\n",
        "\n",
        "A correlation heatmap was then used to further find relationships within the species and their properties.\n",
        "\n",
        "**The results were as follows:**\n",
        "![correlation_heatmap.png](data:image/png;base64,)\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hTfjm8cD9cNU"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "  \n",
        "*   The correlation heatmap allows us to identify the properties that are complimentary. Correlation values usually range from:\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "* +1 → perfect positive correlation\n",
        "\n",
        "* 0 → no correlation\n",
        "\n",
        "* −1 → perfect negative correlation\n",
        "\n",
        "*   Petal width and length show the strongest positive correlation at 0.96.\n",
        "*  While correlation between sepal width and petal properties were generally weaker.\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "qOdv9mgM_1MV"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "# Conclusion\n",
        "\n",
        "*  Petal measurements are the best features for distinguishing iris species.\n",
        "*   Iris-setosa is highly distinct, while Iris-versicolor and Iris-virginica share some similarities but can still be separated using petal size patterns\n",
        "* **Recommendation for future research:** Linear analysis seems to be the most effective method to clearly distinguish the species' properties\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "0L6sQGFX-8-q"
